senses.gloss: אִיסְרָא, אֵיסְרָא; אֵיסַרְתָּא f. bundle, bunch, sheaf.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 19:18">Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 18</cite>.
Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 7; a. e.—Pl. אֵיסָרָן, אֵיסָרָתָא. Ibid. (ed. also אֵסרא, אֵסרתא). אֱסָרָתָא Targ. Ps. II, 3 (some ed. אֵסָרוּ׳) chains; v. preced.
